title: Mask Adoption Dynamics in a Social Population
description: Simulate how individuals adopt mask-wearing over time under the influence of social networks, policies, enforcement, information campaigns, misinformation, costs, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: PeerInfluence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask use among their social network neighbors and update their adoption propensity.

interactions.name: PolicyEnforcement
interactions.description: Mandates and enforcement affect individual compliance via perceived risk of fines and legitimacy.

interactions.name: InformationDiffusion
interactions.description: Media channels and interpersonal sharing change risk perception and beliefs about masks.

interactions.name: PurchaseAndSupply
interactions.description: Individuals attempt to buy masks from retailers subject to inventory, price, and rationing.

interactions.name: LocationAccess
interactions.description: Locations apply mask policies; individuals may be denied entry or fined if noncompliant.

interactions.name: HouseholdInfluence
interactions.description: Household members influence each other's beliefs and share supplies.

interactions.name: RiskFeedback
interactions.description: External or simulated health risk signals influence risk perception and adoption decisions.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Share of individuals wearing masks each day.

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_days
metrics.description: Consecutive days that adoption remains above a threshold.

metrics.name: adoption_by_subgroup
metrics.description: Adoption rates segmented by attributes such as age, income, vulnerability, or political orientation.

metrics.name: mandate_effect_uplift
metrics.description: Difference in adoption attributable to mandates/enforcement compared to counterfactual without mandates.

metrics.name: information_campaign_effect
metrics.description: Change in adoption due to information campaigns versus baseline.

metrics.name: supply_fill_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of mask demand that is satisfied by retailers.

metrics.name: stockout_events
metrics.description: Count of retailer stockout occurrences over the simulation.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Number of enforcement actions (warnings/fines) taken at locations.

metrics.name: inequality_in_adoption
metrics.description: Inequality measure (e.g., Gini) of mask adoption across individuals or subgroups.
